description: Look up a JavaScript file by MD5 across the archive and report its prevalence: total matches, unique scans, first and last seen, a prevalence label and the matching scripts; include_scans adds the scans, from_date and to_date limit the period.

from_date.description: Start of the date range, ISO 8601 (for example 2026-11-01); omit for the API's default.
from_date.title: From Date

hash_value.description: MD5 of a JavaScript file's content (32 hex characters).
hash_value.title: Hash Value

include_scans.description: Also list the scans in which the file appeared.
include_scans.title: Include Scans

to_date.description: End of the date range, ISO 8601 (for example 2026-11-12); omit for the API's default.
to_date.title: To Date

name: search_js_fingerprint_by_md5
title: Search JS Fingerprint By MD5
